name: hilbert-content-ablation-v1
status: post-hoc diagnostic declared after c620019a outcomes; no training or endpoint selection
inputs: all eight original c620019a endpoints, exact metadata/receipt/endpoint/score pins
intact: re-evaluate actual saved model and require every original raw-logit hash and metric to match its saved report exactly
zero-state: set the new block initial state to zero; keep parent, mass, all matrices/readouts/classes/components stored; predictions use7/8 of the original parent logits
training-mean-state: compute the complete complex mean of actual new-block states on original supervised training prefixes, without using target labels; set the new initial state to this mean and every new transition to identity, retaining all learned outputs and the parent; validate feasibility; isolates a constant per-class contribution at the same mass
new-block-only: set all parent learned component weights to zero and put parent mass in its structural zero component, without removing stored components; the new block retains its original mass2; isolates the learned new contribution
mean: all original supervised occurrences, including duplicates and masks, with equal per-occurrence weight; no validation/test input or label is used to construct the mean; original record order retained
reports: all original splits and labels for every declared ablation, raw/exact/CE and original success/99% flags; intact raw replay required; compare content versus constant-state contribution without interpreting an ablation as a newly trained endpoint
claim: post-hoc empirical dependence check; no new optimizer, target identification, generalization proof or certified floating geometry; all original sources and transformer unchanged
